 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 16th Match - Sudurpaschim Royals vs Karnali Yaks and 17th Match - Chitwan Rhinos vs Pokhara Avengers, to be played on the 6th of November at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Sudurpaschim Royals v Karnali Yaks 
 LIVE SCORES - 16th Match - Sudurpaschim Royals vs Karnali Yaks (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137
 Current Form Sudurpaschim Royals: 
 Sudurpaschim Royals are currently placed at the 5th position on points table with 2 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dipendra Singh Airee with 79 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Anil Kharel with 6 scalps under his belt .
 Sudurpaschim Royals have won their previous match against Chitwan Rhinos by 5 wickets.
 Chitwan Rhinos batted first and they posted a total of 129 for 6 in 20 overs. Dev Khanal got out without troubling the scorers much. Dawid Malan and Arjun Saud played cautiously but consumed way too many deliveries before throwing their wicket away. It was Ravi Bopara, who was the lone warrior for the team. He scored 49 runs off 40 deliveries and helped Chitwan Rhinos get past the 120 run mark, as they finished at 129 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sudurpaschim Royals lost the key wickets of Saif Zaib and Binod Bhandari quite early into the innings. After their dismissals, Brandon McMullen and Ishan Pandey took the innings forward. McMullen made 43 off 21 balls while Pandey scored 25 runs to seal the deal in favor of Sudurpaschim Royals. Aarif Sheikh and Sherfane Rutherford also contributed healthily and Sudurpaschim Royals got home in the 17th over itself with 6 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Karnali Yaks: 
 Karnali Yaks are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 2 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 4 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Ariful Islam with 119 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Sompal Kami with 7 scalps under his belt .
 Karnali Yaks have lost their previous match against Kathmandu Gorkhas by 4 wickets.
 Karnali Yaks batted first and they posted a total of 180 for 6 in 20 overs. Jishan Alam got out cheaply. Ariful Islam then combined together Mark Watt to stitch a partnership of 46 runs for the 2nd wicket. Mark Watt consumed 20 deliveries for his knock of 17 runs and it didn't help team much. Ariful Islam went on to score 44 runs in only 22 balls, 5 fours and 3 sixes. Hussain Talat and Gulshan Jha also contributed quite well towards the back end to help Karnali Yaks get to 180 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Kathmandu Gorkhas lost 2 early wickets in the form of David Warner and Smit Patel. Aadil Ansari also consumed 27 deliveries for his knock of 20. It was Rashid Khan and Karan KC, who batted like champions. They scored 50 and 44 runs respectively to take Kathmandu Gorkhas very close to the target. However, both of them got out at a wrong time. Jahandad Khan also played his natural game and made 22 runs to take Kathmandu Gorkhas home with 4 wickets in hand.

 The top wicket taker for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Ranjit Kumar with 4 scalps under his belt .
 Chitwan Rhinos have lost their previous match against Sudurpaschim Royals by 6 wickets.
 Chitwan Rhinos batted first and they posted a total of 129 for 6 in 20 overs. Dev Khanal got out without troubling the scorers much. Dawid Malan and Arjun Saud played cautiously but consumed way too many deliveries before throwing their wicket away. It was Ravi Bopara, who was the lone warrior for the team. He scored 49 runs off 40 deliveries and helped Chitwan Rhinos get past the 120 run mark, as they finished at 129 in 20 overs of play.

 Current Form Pokhara Avengers: 
 Pokhara Avengers are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 3 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name.
 The top run scorer for Pokhara Avengers in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kushal Bhurtel with 70 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Pokhara Avengers in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Shakib Al Hasan with 4 scalps under his belt .
 Pokhara Avengers have lost their previous match against Lumbini Lions by 8 wickets.
 Pokhara Avengers batted first and they posted a very modest total of 97 for 9 in 20 overs. Arjun Kumal, Bipin Acharya and Sadeera Samarawickrama got out within the Powerplay overs and Pokhara Avengers looked in all sorts of bother. The middle order also failed to infuse any momentum into the innings. Chamika Karunaratne fought hard and scored 25 runs but he couldn't get any batter to work with him the way out of troubled waters. Ruben Trumpelmann bowled exceptionally well. He picked up 3 wickets for 16 runs and helped restrict Pokhara Avengers to an under par total of 97 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Lumbini Lions lost the key wickets of Aasif Sheikh and D'Arcy Short quite early. After their dismissals, Rohit Kumar Paudel and Niroshan Dickwella took the responsibility of taking Lumbini Lions over the line. Paudel made 47 while Dickwella scored 27 runs as Lumbini Lions got home in the 12th over itself with 8 wickets in hand.
